meta.title: 3 Days in Da Nang Vietnam 🇻🇳 Best Cafes, Food & Beachfront Hotel | Vietnam Travel Guide 2026
meta.description:
Planning 3 days in Da Nang, Vietnam? 🇻🇳 In this travel vlog, we explore all the best things to do in Da Nang, one of Southeast Asia’s most underrated beach destinations.

Our 3 day itinerary through Central Vietnam starts with a stay at a luxury beachfront hotel with a stunning view of both Da Nang's famous coastline and its lush mountains. From there, we discover the city's vibrant food scene through its best cafes and Michelin-awarded restaurants loved by locals. From a beloved grandmother's banh mi shop to a popular egg coffee spot to a Masterchef owned fish noodle shop, you'll never run out of amazing food in this seaside city.

Whether you’re visiting Vietnam for the first time or planning your next Southeast Asia trip, this Da Nang Vietnam travel vlog will help you discover all the best Vietnamese food, coffee shops and places to visit on your next trip.

#danangvietnam #vietnamtravel #danangtravel

comments.author: @GrandmaVuongs
comments.text:
Thank you for the incredible video, Ralph & Sam. It’s an honor to have our family’s story shared on your channel.

What we do today in Da Nang traces back to my grandmother, who began this craft in 1968. Her methods and discipline live on through my mother and me. 

Our goal has always been simple: protect that tradition and share it with others. As a new Da Nang shop, your support and visibility help us do exactly that and give us every reason to keep going. Thank you.
